goal: Make a serviced Nightshift lens mean a broad, evidence-backed deep review and improve held-out deep-defect recall.

baseline.note: Initial historical replay; the later-invalid open_branch_cap case was excluded because its snapshot documented the behavior as intended.

experiment_1.decision: keep only as an honesty gate; it did not improve recall

experiment_2.lever: Mandatory invariant matrix over config domains, semantic sets, artifact identity, failure translation, and lifecycle
experiment_2.decision: keep; passes the frozen 3-of-4 hit_at_3 gate
experiment_2.remaining_miss: The reviewer restored review/commit tree identity but failed to notice that a green test on a suite-mutated tree did not certify the restored tree.
